facts.assignment: DeSoto County Civil and County Criminal, per profile and printed listing.

procedure_checklist.scheduling: Use JACS after filing the motion; requests over60minutes or unavailable time go to the assistant. Self-represented parties may contact the assistant. No added/cross-noticed matters without required consent; use JACS cancellation or copied cancellation notice to assistant.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Civil non-evidentiary hearings under30minutes may be noticed remotely with access details. Evidentiary and in-person-noticed proceedings ordinarily require physical attendance unless authorized; see source exceptions and Zoom links.
procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Copy all parties; email is not a motion. Assistant handles scheduling, not legal advice or substantive ex parte communications.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Portal encouraged; hard copy accepted but do not duplicate delivery. Submit agreed form or identify disagreements and efforts to obtain agreement.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: Normally unnecessary because court uses electronic file. For substantial materials, searchable electronic copies encouraged at least3days before hearing.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Obtain required consent for additions/cross-notices and proposed-order form; source does not establish a separate general conferral protocol beyond linked rules.
